name: travel-skills
description: Reusable travel planning, source verification, budgeting, safety, multi-agent orchestration, and MCP auditing skills pack for Antigravity and compatible AI agents.
author: Ultimate Travel Agent Contributors

skills.name: travel-planning
skills.description: Best practices and structured protocols for assembling end-to-end travel itineraries across city-trips, road-trips, and nature expeditions.

skills.name: source-verification
skills.description: Protocols for grading information reliability, verifying travel facts, cross-referencing sources, and tagging verification levels.

skills.name: budget-validation
skills.description: Rules and formulas for estimating total trip expenditure, applying multi-currency conversions, factoring safety reserves, and detecting cost overruns.

skills.name: travel-safety
skills.description: Safety protocols, emergency contact verification, embassy registries, outdoor hazard warnings, and health compliance.

skills.name: multi-agent-orchestration
skills.description: Directives for scheduling, wave synchronization, context budget management, and DAG pipeline execution across specialized sub-agents.

skills.name: mcp-skill-auditing
skills.description: Guidelines and automated checks for auditing external MCP servers, tool definitions, URL allowlists, and prompt injection vectors.
